purpose: Root acceptance boundaries for bounded source-state test; not native or policy evidence
independence: Verification replays command state transitions and request accounting from raw records; it does not execute Ramulator or reuse its declared valid flag as proof
scope: eight instrumented frozen cases plus one original-library passivity control; twenty instrumented read executions and five original-control read executions if all succeed
read_completion: accepted request has its own RD, callback at source depart, pending retired after complete tick; unique IDs, complete finite input set
state: all 32 banks and per-bank cap compared against independent ACT/PRE/PREA/RD/REF/end ledger; all declared full snapshots, including before target
drain: all accepted reads to date callbacked, five buffers zero, future action count zero, banks not Refreshing, aligned clocks and next periodic refresh still future
refresh: both ranks need accepted enqueue, actual REFab and actual REFab_end with nRFC-1 offset; command timing readiness checked separately through full node paths
passivity: same physical input yields exact callback and original TraceRecorder command trace for unmodified vs instrumented library in cap4 control
replay: identical O_phys/config/epoch yields exact normalized callback/command/full state records in independent-warm pair; only executed-input conditional check
comparison: same fixed target epoch for short family and for refresh family. Target read latency is a source diagnostic, not full application time or net action benefit. Warm/idle amounts are explicit and not free
negative_mutations: drained flag with pending or future maintenance
deployment: internal hooks and physical history remain model truth. O_host sufficiency, interface acquisition/cost, unseen generalization, P/PN ranking and novelty are unknown
protected: production Linux/RTL/ABI, old M0/CS1/MQSim assets, A5/A2, independent engineering records, MIG paused
